query.description: Limit 설정 화면: Device 의 Para 목록(측정 항목 UPPER 묶음) + 저장된 Limit + READY 파일 값 통계 / 범위 밖 수
query.commandtext: WITH I AS (SELECT ET_ITEM_SEQ, UPPER(PARA_NAME) AS PARA, UNIT, DISPLAY_ORDER FROM TQP_GDS_ET_ITEM WHERE FACTORY = :f1 AND DEVICE_ID = :d1), P AS (SELECT PARA, COUNT(*) AS ITEM_COUNT, MIN(UNIT) AS UNIT, COUNT(DISTINCT UNIT) AS UNIT_KINDS, MIN(DISPLAY_ORDER) AS FIRST_ORDER FROM I GROUP BY PARA), L AS (SELECT * FROM TQP_GDS_ET_LIMIT WHERE FACTORY = :f2 AND DEVICE_ID = :d2), V AS (SELECT I.PARA, V.MEAS_VALUE, V.VALUE_STATUS FROM TQP_GDS_ET_VALUE V JOIN I ON I.ET_ITEM_SEQ = V.ET_ITEM_SEQ JOIN TQP_GDS_SRC_FILE F ON F.SRC_FILE_SEQ = V.SRC_FILE_SEQ WHERE F.FACTORY = :f3 AND F.DEVICE_ID = :d3 AND F.LOAD_STATUS = 'READY'), S AS (SELECT V.PARA, COUNT(V.MEAS_VALUE) AS VALUE_COUNT, SUM(CASE WHEN V.VALUE_STATUS = 'N' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS NOT_TESTED_COUNT, MIN(V.MEAS_VALUE) AS MIN_VALUE, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY V.MEAS_VALUE) AS MEDIAN_VALUE, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.99) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY V.MEAS_VALUE) AS P99_VALUE, MAX(V.MEAS_VALUE) AS MAX_VALUE, SUM(CASE WHEN L.ENABLE_FLAG = 'Y' AND V.VALUE_STATUS = 'V' AND ((L.LOWER_LIMIT IS NOT NULL AND V.MEAS_VALUE < L.LOWER_LIMIT) OR (L.UPPER_LIMIT IS NOT NULL AND V.MEAS_VALUE > L.UPPER_LIMIT)) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS OUT_COUNT FROM V LEFT JOIN L ON L.PARA_NAME = V.PARA GROUP BY V.PARA) SELECT NVL(P.PARA, L.PARA_NAME) AS PARA_NAME, NVL(P.UNIT, L.UNIT) AS UNIT, NVL(P.UNIT_KINDS, 0) AS UNIT_KINDS, NVL(P.ITEM_COUNT, 0) AS ITEM_COUNT, NVL(S.VALUE_COUNT, 0) AS VALUE_COUNT, NVL(S.NOT_TESTED_COUNT, 0) AS NOT_TESTED_COUNT, S.MIN_VALUE, S.MEDIAN_VALUE, S.P99_VALUE, S.MAX_VALUE, NVL(S.OUT_COUNT, 0) AS OUT_COUNT, L.LOWER_LIMIT, L.UPPER_LIMIT, L.ENABLE_FLAG, L.REMARK, NVL(L.UPDATE_USER, L.CREATE_USER) AS UPDATE_USER, NVL(L.UPDATE_TIME, L.CREATE_TIME) AS UPDATE_TIME, CASE WHEN L.PARA_NAME IS NULL THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y' END AS HAS_LIMIT FROM P FULL OUTER JOIN L ON L.PARA_NAME = P.PARA LEFT JOIN S ON S.PARA = P.PARA ORDER BY NVL(P.FIRST_ORDER, 999999999), NVL(P.PARA, L.PARA_NAME)
SELECT PARA_NAME, LOWER_LIMIT, UPPER_LIMIT, UNIT, ENABLE_FLAG, REMARK FROM TQP_GDS_ET_LIMIT WHERE FACTORY = :factory AND DEVICE_ID = :device_id ORDER BY PARA_NAME

query.description: Limit 저장 (있으면 수정 / 없으면 추가, InsertExecuteMultiple)
query.commandtext: MERGE INTO TQP_GDS_ET_LIMIT T USING (SELECT :factory AS FACTORY, :device_id AS DEVICE_ID, :para_name AS PARA_NAME, TO_BINARY_DOUBLE(:lower_limit) AS LOWER_LIMIT, TO_BINARY_DOUBLE(:upper_limit) AS UPPER_LIMIT, :unit AS UNIT, :enable_flag AS ENABLE_FLAG, :remark AS REMARK, :update_user AS UPDATE_USER FROM DUAL) S ON (T.FACTORY = S.FACTORY AND T.DEVICE_ID = S.DEVICE_ID AND T.PARA_NAME = S.PARA_NAME) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET T.LOWER_LIMIT = S.LOWER_LIMIT, T.UPPER_LIMIT = S.UPPER_LIMIT, T.UNIT = S.UNIT, T.ENABLE_FLAG = S.ENABLE_FLAG, T.REMARK = S.REMARK, T.UPDATE_USER = S.UPDATE_USER, T.UPDATE_TIME = SYSDATE WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (FACTORY, DEVICE_ID, PARA_NAME, LOWER_LIMIT, UPPER_LIMIT, UNIT, ENABLE_FLAG, REMARK, CREATE_USER, CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_USER, UPDATE_TIME) VALUES (S.FACTORY, S.DEVICE_ID, S.PARA_NAME, S.LOWER_LIMIT, S.UPPER_LIMIT, S.UNIT, S.ENABLE_FLAG, S.REMARK, S.UPDATE_USER, SYSDATE, S.UPDATE_USER, SYSDATE)

query.description: Para Limit 1행 삭제 (판정 안 함으로 돌아감)
query.commandtext: DELETE FROM TQP_GDS_ET_LIMIT WHERE FACTORY = :factory AND DEVICE_ID = :device_id AND PARA_NAME = :para_name
